translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yesu tovedawodawowo gisiveyawana.
Tu Yesu oyeya gihobuꞋela ada yoꞋo keke kabiꞋona hivebwaꞋuliyena.
Au tovedawodawowo saꞋeyana Bana againe giꞋela, tugana giveꞋetodonena ada gigahena gigayo, “Kauveya, kaꞋi O nuwanuwa amine o afaiweya yaku aulolo unakolana.”
Gigahe-yo Yesu nimana gitunena be gikibwaꞋena ada gigahena gigayo, “Ika, Iya nuwanuwaku. Unayamumu.” Ada auheꞋama ana dawodawowo gihavaina.

Ada Yesu gigahena gigayo, “Unogali. Keke tamo hakwadi unavenuwaꞋatani, au abaveyao ana tofaisewa againe unamaduna ada wowo unavehawalena. GinaꞋita-yo manuga luhei kadu sifi higa abaveyao Mosese boi tuwai-moꞋena givehimeyena amine ma unanauwedi be moyaꞋaidi o uyamumu velemoꞋena ma hinahalamanena.”
Yesu Loma togiyomatana ana agetoga gisiveyawana.

Gina tu Yesu Kafeneumi againe giluku ada Loma togiyomatana saꞋeyana Bana againe giꞋela, gihawayafeyafena gigayo, “Kauveya, aku agetoga manuweya gidadauda, giꞋaulolo lakahina walogina gisiꞋuwana ada givedivediwe.”
Bana Yesu gigayo, “GanaꞋela be ganasiveyawana.”
Bana togiyomatana gigahena gigayo, “Keke Kauveya, iya keke kaliva yamumuku yo yaku manuweya afaiweya unaluku. Au hidedei unamiya tu unavehimeya be O bonaniga aku agetoga ginasiveyawana.

Hidede amine afaiweya unavehimeya ma a gahalamanena, faꞋina iya kadu abavehimeya gahalamanena. Yaku tonagona yana vehimeya dibune gamimiyami, kadu yaku tolugaviyamomo yaku vehimeya dibune himimiyami. Yaku tolugaviya saꞋeyana gavehimeyena gagayo, Una, ada au gitowamidi be gina. Kadu velugana gagahena gagayo, UꞋela weꞋai, ada au giꞋela. Kadu aku agetoga againe gagahe gagayo, Hidedemi unafaisewa, ada au yaku vehimeya amine gifaisewa.”

Ada Yesu togiyomatana yana gahe ginogalini-yo giyaulowoga, ada kaliva hivebwaꞋuliyena-ma gigahedi gigayo, “Biyao! Wona velemona keke-moꞋa tamo kwanaIsileli yana wavetumagana gadanuhagani hidevama kwanaLoma yana vetumagana amine.

E, gagahemi tova mulina kaliva moyaꞋaidi fafali tulina tulina walaubeꞋuya kadu waꞋoyeya hinaꞋela, Yaubada yana abageya hinaluku be yana tolameya hinavetoga. Ide miIsileli bwanenedeyao Abelahamo Aisake Yakobu badi buye hinavetoga Yaubada yana avemwamwala hinaꞋana lobameya.

Tu ide omi miIsileli vaita Yaubada yana yoꞋo kalivadi tu keke wadavetumagana velemoꞋena faꞋina kabuꞋavane hinahegemi be umalovaneya wanamiyami, ada medede againe wanatagitagi lakahina kumimi wanahobeꞋuwana nuwami ginavekubokubo.”

Ada Yesu hidedemi gilukahihi gihavaina togiyomatana gigahena gigayo, “Unana ya manuweya ada gavadi faꞋina uvetumaganeku amine, au hidedemi ginalakayemu.” Ada au medema kauwanai-nadi togiyomatana ana agetoga giyamumu.
Yesu kaliva vevine moyaꞋaidi gisiveyawadi.
Bana togiyomatana gina tu Yesu Fita yana manuweya giluku, ada Fita lawana giꞋitadi adi iviya hidadauda wowodi vaita ai.
Au nimadi giꞋabina ada wowodi auheꞋama gituluna, au himidi be hivebutu Yesu anaga hikidewedewena.
Ada mala gilavina kaliva moyaꞋaidi yafune hiluvaiyedi-ma tobohiyadiyao Yesu againe hiꞋaliyedi, ada yana vehimeya againe yafune giwavidi. Kadu toꞋaulolo moyaꞋaidi gisiveyawa-Ꞌowodi.
Ada hidedemi gifaisewa be Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Aiseya giyakahina-ma ginalakayemu velemoꞋena faꞋina. Boi tuwai-moꞋena bana Aiseya gigaheye-vagahina gigayo,

content.text: Bana Tauna yada aulolo moyaꞋaina givaihegena, kadu ada vita gihawatana be ginahavaina.

content: Hidedemi Aiseya gigahe.
Kaliva adiꞋiselu Yesu ana muliya faꞋina higa-wayoga.
Tu Yesu yoꞋo lakahidi himidififina-ma giꞋitadi againe, ana tomuliya givehimeyedi be badi Bana buye tobu yuwa fafaline hinana.
Tu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala saꞋeyana Bana againe giꞋela gigahena gigayo, “Tovehawala, gahawahegeku be haꞋamine haꞋamine unana, iya kadu O buye kanana.”
Bana Yesu gigayo, “GaluꞋeta-walawalaꞋa adi wagou kadu manuga adi waꞋuba tu Iya TohobuꞋela yaku abamiya keke, kadu yaku abaveyawai keke. Au aku muliya vitana.”
Kadu kaliva velugana, higa ana tomuliya saꞋeyana, gigahena gigayo, “Kauveya, udahawahegeku be gadamiyami tu bana kamaku gadatauni-yo gadaꞋela gadamuliye.”
Bana Yesu gigahena gigayo, “Badi yawaidi ivaguna keke amanadi yadi toꞋalika hinatauna. OꞋeni ma auheꞋama unamuliyeku.”
Yesu mala lakahina gihawatana be giꞋalovena.
Yesu gilukahihi gihavaina, wakeya giyage ana tomuliya buyeꞋi.
Ada auheꞋama mala koyona tobu againe gilakayemu, bolimanakouko gimadu ada lefo lakahina waka tabone giꞋayavalina. Tu bana Yesu ma giꞋenonuwaulu.
Badi tomuliya hina hiluvaguna higahena higayo, “Kauveya, unalugolegoleda, kabiꞋona kanaꞋalika.”
Bana Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “Gavadi-yo wamatautaveꞋine? Yami vetumagana au kabiꞋona.” Au gimidi bolimana lefo gihawatadi, ada au giꞋalove-Ꞌowona.
Ada tomuliya hiyaulowoga au hiveꞋagahegahe higayo, “Biyao! Bana hima gava kaliva? Taumadi, bolimana kadu lefo Bana bonana giꞋabina!”
Yesu kaliva adiꞋiselu wayafunediyao gikiveyamumudi.

Tu Yesu miGadala yadi fafali yuwa tobu fafaline gilakayemu, ada kaliva adiꞋiselu wayafunediyao edeya himaduhagana. Badi yadi abamiyami tomohuyehuyeya, ada yafune hiluvaiyedi faꞋina badi manimaninidiyao, au kaliva vevine moyaꞋaidi himatausedi faꞋina keke medema edai-nadi againe hidanauna.

Yesu hiꞋita-yo hikovaꞋawafatafata higayo, “OꞋeni Yaubada Natuna. Gavadi ime agaimeya unagani-yo uꞋela? Ime yafune ama vematahiwadi ana tova au aimo tova mulina tu kaꞋi O uꞋela be unamadu-kivetavetagigima?” Hidedemi higahe.
Tu yuwa oya fafaline bawe adi yoꞋo lakahina adiga hilelele.
Au yafune Yesu againe hiveꞋoꞋoladona higayo, “KaꞋi unawavima digo, udavehimeyema be yuwa bawe moyaꞋaidi adaluvaiyedi.”
Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “Au wana.” Ada au kaliva hinuyabuyabudi-yo bawe hiluvaiyedi, au bawe matatabudi awaloloya hiꞋotahobu, tobu againe hitowaꞋalika.
Tu bawe adi tolufolofologahi hiꞋota be hina melaleya, bawe valeyadi kaliva agaidiya hiꞋawatalatalainena, kadu kaliva wayafunediyao agaidiya gavadi gilakayemu-ma hilukahihiyena.
Ada au kaliva moyaꞋaidi hinu-Ꞌowoga be Yesu hinaꞋitana. Ada hiyemu hiꞋitana againe, higaheyaꞋayaꞋalina be yadi fafali ginanuyabuyabuna.
